title: B3DonorPairAdmissionChecklist
description: Admission criteria and schema verification checklist for candidate pairs in the B3 diagnostic arm.

byte_identity.rule: Exact byte match with frozen clean TRAIN bank record required.
byte_identity.format_mismatch_policy: Mismatches must be reported as unresolved. Normalizing bank bytes or asserting pre-approved formatting transforms is strictly forbidden.

required_pair_fields.source_url: string (direct URL to source commit or file)
required_pair_fields.source.before: string (archived exact vulnerable function code, label 1)
required_pair_fields.source.after: string (archived exact fixed function code, label 0)
required_pair_fields.before_sha256: string (SHA256 hex digest of source.before UTF-8 bytes)
required_pair_fields.after_sha256: string (SHA256 hex digest of source.after UTF-8 bytes)
required_pair_fields.source.fix_diff: string (actual unified diff between before and after confirming changed lines)
required_pair_fields.security_rationale: string (factual rationale describing the vulnerability fix)
required_pair_fields.key_difference: string (generated explanation of key differences between before and after)
required_pair_fields.reviews: array of review objects (exactly 2 distinct human reviews)

review_schema.human_verification_rule: Real source authentication and security semantics require human inspection. Local declarations and hash consistency checks do not prove source authenticity.

field_specifications.reviewer: string (identifier of the genuine human reviewer)
field_specifications.payload_sha256: string (SHA256 hex digest of UTF-8 JSON of full pair object excluding 'reviews', sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'))

selection_protocol.algorithm: Exact exhaustive mean token-set Jaccard similarity of target code with both verified donor functions (source.before, source.after)

prompt_and_budget_constraints.oversized_pair_rule: Must halt execution immediately. Silent reselection, truncation of causal evidence, or token clipping is strictly prohibited.
prompt_and_budget_constraints.empty_pool_rule: Pause execution immediately. There is no authorized fallback arm.

governance_freeze.threshold_policy: Full new validation run required. Candidate thresholds must be recorded in a separate candidate threshold artifact. Modifying locked configs is strictly forbidden.
governance_freeze.protocol_authority: Any protocol change requires an explicit documented governance decision. This guide does not authorize any protocol changes.
